title: Biological assembly as a surface
prompt: Load oxyhaemoglobin (1HHO) as its biological assembly (the tetramer, assembly 1) and show it as a molecular surface.

provenance.derived: The July task asked for assembly 1 of 6VXX, which is identical to the deposited model, so the request tested nothing. 1HHO deposits one alpha-beta dimer; assembly 1 applies two symmetry operators to make the tetramer (checked with `scripts/check_api_refs.py --cif`).

notes: An answer that loads the deposited model shows half the molecule.
